name: ZCH_SETUP_VALIDATIONS
description: This table store the validation results for Customer Data Management configuration setting.

columns.name: SETUP_VALIDATION_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key of this record.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Identifier for validation report submission process.

columns.name: VALIDATION_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Validation rule for Customer Data Management configuration settings. Refer lookup table, for type ORA_ZCH_SETUP_VALIDATIONS, to view all supported lookup values.

columns.name: SEVERITY_LEVEL
columns.description: Validation severity for Customer Data Management configuration settings. Refer lookup table, for type ORA_ZCH_SETUP_SEVERITY, to view all supported lookup values. Possible values: ORA_ZCH_SEVERITY_WARNING, ORA_ZCH_SEVERITY_URGENT, ORA_ZCH_SEVERITY_INFORMATION.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION
columns.description: Recommendation messages shown to customer to guide them to fix the reported configuration issue.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN
columns.description: Store message token value if message has token.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VALIDATION_STATUS
columns.description: Store evaluation status of the validation  result.
